Hi Elena — great to meet earlier, thanks for the clear list. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

Recap
- Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private and Dedicated: we can integrate with AWS KMS and Google KMS via a CMK binding flow. For hosted (multi-tenant) we offer envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys but can provide additional isolation for enterprise tiers.
- HSM: we provide an HSM-backed KMS integration option (Cloud HSM / AWS CloudHSM). We can also support customer-supplied HSMs in our Private on-prem package; FIPS 140-2 Level 2/3 details are in the security pack.
- Encryption: in transit we use TLS 1.2+/1.3; at rest we use AES-256-GCM with per-tenant envelope keys and KV cache lifecycle controls.
- Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for our serving platform; we have HIPAA BAAs for enterprise customers and provide GDPR-data processing addenda. I'll confirm timing for delivering the latest SOC 2 report.

Proposed next steps
1) I'll loop in our security & encryption leads with the questionnaire. (cc'd below)
2) Please attach the vendor questionnaire (or confirm you already sent it). We'll return completed answers and propose a 30-min follow-up the week of 5/24.
3) We'll include a short BYOK options doc (diagram + comparison table).

Want to confirm: is MedAlign planning to host in us-west-2 (AWS) or GCP in us-central? That will help us tailor the KMS integration notes.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (security) and Neha (encryption) to own the questionnaire and tech options.

Regards,

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks, and apologies for the short delay. See answers below and attached artifacts.

SOC 2 / Compliance
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our inference platform in Q1 2027. We can share the bridge letter and a redacted SOC 2 report under NDA; timeline to produce an un-redacted report for procurement is ~3 business days after we receive a signed NDA.
- HIPAA: we execute BAAs for enterprise customers. Addenda for GDPR/DPA are also available.

Encryption & Keys (summary)
- Hosted (public API): envelope encryption with Redwood-managed CMKs; no customer KMS integration in multi-tenant. We offer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for our Dedicated and Private offerings.
- BYOK integration: supports AWS KMS (CMK import OR CMK binding), GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. For HSM-backed needs, we support AWS CloudHSM and customer-supplied HSMs in Private deployments.
- Key lifecycle: customer CMKs are used to wrap/unwrap per-tenant data keys. Rotation is supported; logs for key usage are retained and can be exported for audit.

Security artifacts attached:
- key-ops-diagram.pdf (diagram of envelope encryption + BYOK flow)
- kms-options-table.csv (feature/ops comparison across KMS options)

Next steps
- If you email the questionnaire (or confirm it was attached), we'll return a draft within 3 business days.
- Suggest a 30-min technical sync on Tues 5/25 to walk the diagram and pick the right integration pattern.

Thanks,
